newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint ends up vs dlr, BCE Swiss franc futures slip.
newsitem.headline: Forint ends up vs dlr, BCE Swiss franc futures slip.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed a shade firmer against the dollar on Friday with range trading dominating the interbank forex market, dealers said.
The forint closed at 155.60/65 to the dollar compared with its opening of 155.65/70.
"There was very little trading during the day," said Peter Luczo of Inter-Europa Bank.
The forint remained pinned to the central bank's bid.
On the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE), Swiss franc futures dropped in all but one maturity.
